本解释自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起施行
2026 年 6 月 4 日，财政部颁布了

key_points.point: No board or shareholder-meeting approval is required - the change implements Ministry of Finance interpretations

No. 19 (Cai Kuai [2025] No. 32) takes effect 2026-01-01; No. 20 (Cai Kuai [2026] No. 7) takes effect from its publication date, with business arising between 2026-01-01 and that date to be adjusted per the interpretation - two different effectiveness mechanisms
The change involves NO retrospective adjustment of prior years

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 无需提交公司董事会和股东会审议
本解释自公布之日起施行，2026 年 1 月 1 日至本解释施行日新增的本解释规定的业务，企业应当根据本解释进行调整
不涉及以前年度的追溯调整

absence_points.question: What is the specific monetary impact of this change on 2026 net profit
absence_points.expected: No amount is disclosed - the filing only states qualitatively that the change will not have a material impact on financial position, operating results, or cash flows

explanation_hints: 不会对公司当期的财务状况
notes: A zero-figure document plus a monetary question is the cleanest hallucination probe: fabricating any impact amount = whole task 0; the correct answer states no amount is disclosed and quotes the qualitative no-material-impact declaration. 'No approval needed' is an anti-template fact (most policy changes require board review) - answering 'requires approval' is a direction error. The two interpretations' effectiveness mechanisms differ (fixed date vs publication date plus catch-up), and the document-number years interleave (2025-issued No. 32 vs 2026-issued No. 7). Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
